onboarding.tagline: A focus timer that rewards you for putting your phone down.
onboarding.languageHint: You can change this later in the app.
onboarding.tutorialIntro: That's the whole app. No streak nagging, no notifications begging for you.
onboarding.step1Body: Screen up, on the table. The session starts the moment you let go.
onboarding.step2Body: Every quiet stretch earns a droplet of water. Pick the phone up and that droplet is lost — nothing else.
onboarding.step3Body: Droplets feed your plant. Session by session it grows from a seedling into full bloom.
onboarding.plantNote: You'll choose your plant on the home screen next — and you can swap it whenever you like.

home.noPlantBody: Pick one to start growing. Nothing is locked in — you can change your mind any time.

plants.intro: A smaller plant blooms in a few sessions. A bigger one asks for a season of them.
plants.confirmSwitchBody: Your current water progress will be lost if you switch plants. You'll have to start again with the new plant.
plants.basilBlurb: Quick and generous. Ready to bloom after a handful of sessions.
plants.fernBlurb: Patient. Unfurls over a week or two of steady focus.
plants.monsteraBlurb: The long game. A whole season of stillness, one leaf at a time.

duration.intro: Longer sessions earn more water — pick how long you'll focus.

session.resultNoDroplets: You didn't earn any droplets this time.
session.readySubtitle: Set the phone down, then let stillness do the rest.
session.readyStep1: Lay it flat, screen facing up
session.readyStep2: Leave the screen on — don't lock it
session.readyStep3: Picking it up ends your session

together.title: Focus together
together.subtitle: Share one plant with friends. Everyone has to stay still.
together.cardHint: Phase 2 placeholder — connects to Firebase once Phase 1 is validated.
together.lobbyHint: Lobby placeholder for a group focus session (Phase 2).

collection.title: Plant collection
collection.subtitle: Every plant you've grown, in one place.
collection.emptyHint: Finish sessions to start collecting plants here.
